newsitem.title: UK: UK cargo wholesaler ICM eyes Europe subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: UK cargo wholesaler ICM eyes Europe subsidiaries.

text.p: UK airfreight wholesaler International Cargo Marketing (ICM) is considering starting new subsidiaries in continental Europe, initially in the Netherlands and France, managing director Terry Greetham said.

"I can see a market for an ICM operation on the continent. (Continental) Europeans seem less inclined than the British to plunge into wholesale freight operations. Perhaps we are a bit more basic down to earth approach to the market, but the opportunity is there," he told Reuters.
However Greetham gave no timescale for the operational start-up of the proposed subsidiaries.
ICM was established in 1988 by the cargo division of British Midland. It now has associations with over 200 airlines and publishes an ex-UK wholesale tariff featuring 800 destinations worldwide.
